about.heading: About Your Photographer
paragraphs: I'm Brian Weith, a professional real estate photographer and videographer helping agents, brokers, and homeowners create compelling visual content that gets listings noticed and sold.
With a background in professional photography, I bring both technical precision and a trained artistic eye to every property I visit — whether it's a starter condo or a luxury home.
Fast turnaround, transparent pricing, and easy to work with. That's my promise.
